summary.text: Kathy Edmonston is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 88, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Ascension Parish. First elected in 2019, Kathy Edmonston serves as vice chair of the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Kathy Edmonston's occupation as parent facilitator for the Ascension Parish School Board, with a B.A. in English from Louisiana State University.

The House page lists Kathy Edmonston's committee assignments as Judiciary (vice chair), Civil Law and Procedure, Education, House Select Committee on Homeland Security, and House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Capital Region Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, and Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
